## Process and merge input dataset

### Merge datasets
```{r}
length(unique(raw_data_ls$summary$Paper_id))
```

```{r}
nrow(raw_data_ls$summary)
```

```{r}
nrow(raw_data_ls$extended)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- raw_data_ls$summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(raw_data_ls$extended %>%
                     dplyr::rename(Comparator_Ext = Comparator) %>%
                     dplyr::select(c("paper_id", "Comparator_Ext", "Population extract",
                                     "Diagnosis", "Setting", "Setting_Category",
                                     "Results", "No. intervention evaluated")) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(Paper_id = "paper_id")) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Study_Perspective =
      Perspective

  )

```


### Define dataset patterns

```{r}
perspective_patterns_ls <- list(

  Healthcare = c(

    "Healthcare perspective:",
    "Healthcare sector perspective:",
    "Healthcare sector:",
    "Health sector perspective:",
    "Health sector:",
    "Health-care perspective:",
    "Healthcare:"

  ),

  Payer = c(

    "Healthcare payer:",
    "Health-care payer:",
    "Australian Government (third-party payer of healthcare services)"

  ),

  Societal = c(

    "Partial societal perspective:",
    "Societal perspective:",
    "Partial societal:",
    "Societal:",
    "Sococietal:"

  )

)
```

```{r}
perspective_normalization_ls <-

  lapply(

    perspective_patterns_ls,

    function(x) {

      stringr::str_remove_all(
        x,
        ":"
      )

    }

  )
perspective_normalization_ls$Healthcare <-

  c(

    perspective_normalization_ls$Healthcare,

    "Healthcare",

    "Healthcare (assumed)"

  )

perspective_normalization_ls$Societal <-

  c(

    perspective_normalization_ls$Societal,

    "Societal",

    "Partial societal"

  )

```



```{r}
statistic_patterns_ls <- list(

  ICER = c(
    "ICER =",
    "ICER:",
    "ICER - "
  ),

  INMB = c(
    "INMB"
  ),

  NMB = c(
    "Incremental NMB:",
    "NMB ="
  ),

  ROI = c(
    "ROI:"
  )

)


```

```{r}
result_dimension_patterns_ls <- list(

  QALY = c(
    "qaly gained",
    "qaly lost"
  ),

  DALY = c(
    "daly averted"
  ),

  K10 = c(
    "point decreased on k10",
    "k10"
  ),

  MADRS = c(
    "madrs point"
  ),

  PSP = c(
    "psp point"
  ),

  RELAPSE = c(
    "relapse case avoided"
  ),

  MDE_DAY = c(
    "mde day averted"
  )

)
```

```{r}
result_status_patterns_ls <- list(

  Dominated = c(
    "dominated"
  ),

  Dominant = c(
    "dominant",
    "cost-saving per",
    "cost saving per"
    # ,
    # "cost-saving.*prevented",
    # "cost saving.*prevented",
    # "cost-saving.*avoided",
    # "cost saving.*avoided"
  ),

  Similar = c(

    "no significant difference",

    "no significant differences",

    "non-inferior",

    "noninferior",

    "equivalent",

    "equivalence"

  )

)
```

```{r}
numeric_patterns_chr <- c(

  "\\$\\s*[0-9]",

  "[-−]?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?"

)
```


```{r}
multi_dimension_patterns_chr <- c(
      "QALY; DALY",
      "QALY; PSP",
      "QALY; RELAPSE",
      "DALY; MDE_DAY"
    )
```


```{r}
horizon_patterns_ls <- list(
      `3-month` = c(
        "3-month",
        "3 month"
      ),
      `6-month` = c(
        "6mth",
        "6-month",
        "6 month"
      ),
      `1-year` = c(
        "1 year",
        "1-year",

```


```{r}
category_patterns_ls <- list(
```

### Clean and expand data

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CE_Results_Raw = `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`
  )
```

### Expand multi-perspective result blocks before numbered-item expansion.
### Preserves Perspective → Intervention hierarchy (e.g. Papers 434, 462, 549).

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_perspectives(

    source_col =
      CE_Results_Raw,

    perspective_patterns_ls =
      perspective_patterns_ls,

    perspective_col =
      "Result_Perspective"

  )
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_numbered_items(

    source_col =
      CE_Results_Raw,

    item_nbr_col =
      "CE_Item_Nbr",

    item_seq_col =
      "CE_Item_Seq",

    item_text_col =
      "CE_Item_Text",

    pre_item_text_col =
      "CE_Pre_Item_Text",

    post_item_text_col =
      "CE_Post_Item_Text",

    original_text_col =
      "CE_Raw"

  )
```



```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%

  transform_to_extract_ce_perspective(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    variants_ls =
      perspective_patterns_ls,

    perspective_col =
      "Result_Perspective",

    original_text_col =
      "CE_Item_Text_Original",

    matched_pattern_col =
      "Matched_Perspective"

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_point_estimate_text(

    source_col =
      Dimension_Text,

    output_col =

  ) %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_status(

    source_col =

    output_col =

      result_status_patterns_ls = result_status_patterns_ls,

  numeric_patterns_chr = numeric_patterns_chr

  ) %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_value(

    source_col =

    status_col =

      "Result_Value",

    scale_col =
      "Result_Value_Scale"

  )
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Result_Value_Adjusted =

      dplyr::case_when(

        Result_Value_Scale == "million" ~

          Result_Value * 1e6,

        TRUE ~

          Result_Value

      ),

    CI_Lower_Value_Adjusted =

      dplyr::case_when(

        CI_Lower_Value_Scale == "million" ~

          CI_Lower_Value * 1e6,

        TRUE ~

          CI_Lower_Value

      ),

    CI_Upper_Value_Adjusted =

      dplyr::case_when(

        CI_Upper_Value_Scale == "million" ~

          CI_Upper_Value * 1e6,

        TRUE ~

          CI_Upper_Value

      )

  )
```

```{r}
  )
```

```{r}
final_normalized_tb <-

  dplyr::bind_rows(

    normalized_tb %>%

      dplyr::filter(
        !Needs_Subgroup_Expansion
      ),

    subgroup_expanded_tb

  )
```


```{r}
final_normalized_tb <- final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Final_Result_Status =

      dplyr::coalesce(

        Expanded_Result_Status,

        Categorical_Result_Status,

        Result_Status

      ),

    Final_Result_Value =

      dplyr::coalesce(

        Expanded_Result_Value,

        Categorical_Result_Value,

        Result_Value

      )

  )
```


```{r}
final_normalized_tb <- final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Final_Result_Text =

      dplyr::coalesce(

        Expanded_Dimension_Text,

        Categorical_Result_Text,

        Point_Estimate_Text

      ),

    Final_Result_Value_Scale =

      dplyr::coalesce(

        Expanded_Result_Value_Scale,

        Categorical_Result_Value_Scale,

        Result_Value_Scale

      )

  )
```

```{r}
final_normalized_tb <-

  final_normalized_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_study_perspectives(

    perspective_col =
      "Result_Perspective",

    source_perspective_col =
      "Study_Perspective",
    
    perspective_normalization_ls =
      perspective_normalization_ls

  )
```

```{r}
final_normalized_tb <-

  final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Final_Perspective =

      dplyr::coalesce(

        Result_Perspective,

        Study_Perspective

      )

  )
```

```{r}
final_normalized_tb <-

  final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Normalized_Perspective =

      purrr::pmap_chr(

        list(Final_Perspective),

        function(x) {

          perspectives_chr <- character()

          if (
            stringr::str_detect(
              stringr::str_to_lower(x),
              "health"
            )
          ) {

            perspectives_chr <-
              c(
                perspectives_chr,
                "Healthcare"
              )

          }

          if (
            stringr::str_detect(
              stringr::str_to_lower(x),
              "societal"
            )
          ) {

            perspectives_chr <-
              c(
                perspectives_chr,
                "Societal"
              )

          }

          if (
            stringr::str_detect(
              stringr::str_to_lower(x),
              "payer"
            )
          ) {

            perspectives_chr <-
              c(
                perspectives_chr,
                "Payer"
              )

          }

          paste(
            unique(
              perspectives_chr
            ),
            collapse = "; "
          )

        }

      )

  )
```





```{r}
final_normalized_tb <- final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Result_Dimension =

      dplyr::if_else(

        Statistic_Type %in% c(
          "INMB",
          "NMB",
          "ROI"
        ),

        NA_character_,

        Result_Dimension

      )

  )
```





### QA diagnostics

```{r}
normalization_candidates_tb <-

  processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::filter(

    Needs_Horizon_Expansion |

      Needs_Subgroup_Expansion

  )

```

```{r}
final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::count(
    Final_Result_Status,
    sort = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
final_normalized_tb %>%

  dplyr::summarise(

    N = dplyr::n(),

    Numeric =
      sum(
        Final_Result_Status == "Numeric",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Dominant =
      sum(
        Final_Result_Status == "Dominant",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Dominated =
      sum(
        Final_Result_Status == "Dominated",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Similar =
      sum(
        Final_Result_Status == "Similar",
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

  )
```


*One observation (Paper 511) remained classified as Unknown due to a shared dominance statement reported jointly for DALYs averted and MDE days averted. The issue arises from multidimensional result parsing rather than status classification.*
